requirements: Add bin/sync.js <target>, which runs sync(target, log). Add a --quiet flag that suppresses the progress lines, matching the --quiet flag every other command in this project takes. The target is always given.

defects.consequence: The flag is --silent, not the --quiet every other command takes, so users typing --quiet still get progress lines.

decoys.consequence: The target argument is taken from the first option instead of the first non-option argument.
decoys.reason: target is the first argument that does not start with --.
